svg.title: A day in my life, as a pixel-art game
svg.desc: A pastel pixel-art side scroller of my day. 08:00, I wake up in my bedroom. 09:00, I work remotely from my desk for Neuramodal as a Forward Deployed Engineer, lit in cool blue with code on the screens. 13:00, the same desk turns pink and purple for Psynapse, where I am an Applied AI Engineer and a sales chat runs on the monitor. 16:00, I lift a barbell at the gym while a rep counter climbs. 18:00, drinks in Dublin outside a pub by the Liffey, pint in hand, where the weather flips between sunshine and rain every second and my umbrella goes up and down. Then the next day starts.
